def transform(grid):
    """Extend each 2 upward by four cells and each 8 upward by three.

    The marker stays at the top of its stem; intermediate cells are 1s.
    All other cells are unchanged.
    """
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r, row in enumerate(grid):
        for c, value in enumerate(row):
            if value == 2:
                height = 4
            elif value == 8:
                height = 3
            else:
                continue
            top = max(0, r - height)
            for rr in range(top, r):
                out[rr][c] = value if rr == top else 1
    return out


if __name__ == "__main__":
    demo_input = [[0] * 10 for _ in range(13)]
    demo_input[9] = [1, 1, 2, 1, 1, 1, 8, 1, 1, 1]

    expected[6][2] = expected[7][2] = expected[8][2] = 1
    expected[6][6] = 8
    expected[7][6] = expected[8][6] = 1
    expected[9] = demo_input[9][:]
    assert transform(demo_input) == expected
